checks.result: 19 skills (14 Active, 5 Passive) match all 57 M0 golden cases incl. Sanctuary tick times/raw tick power, Kyrie shield power, Resurrection HP/SP and Asura all-current SP. Every Active at every level 1-10 resolved in the engine probe (seed 1, 60s; dead ally for Resurrection, 5 starting spheres for sphere skills) and produced every effect (heal, buffs, HoT ticks with parent cast, shield, revive, sphere gain, Asura/Finger/Triple damage, Steel Body guard/provoke/slow) on allowed targets in program order. Every Passive changes stats or procs at levels 1-10 (Spirit Combo grants spheres on normal hits). Priest/Monk skill pages list only root+own-branch skills with effect text; all 19 resolve pack icon/recipe/sound.

Heal Lv10 on a full-HP party still cast 9 times in queue order, spent 162 SP, effective 0 / overheal 12672. Monk finisher: spheres stay within 0..5 at every 500ms sample, every Asura start leaves 0 SP and 0 spheres (spent [407, 60, 48, 60]), 5 sphere(s) wasted at cap; a Stun resolving at 3686ms (inside the 3523–4379ms Asura cast) interrupts Asura (attributed to the stunner), 407 SP stays spent, no damage, no refund. Steel Body Lv10: guard 0→0.4, attack speed 106→74.2 (−30%), and the boss switches its normal attacks from the front ally to the Monk.

catalogQueueTrace of all 4 builds (compiled from validated account characters, no early locked skill) equals the M0 queue_estimate; learned Passives change the trace stats. Full engine fights keep the dry first cycle for both Priest builds, while Asura spends the live SP pool (407 then 60/48) and Spirit Combo refills spheres for the finisher, and Steel Body's slow delays the steel-tank's next start.

Story 6-20 seed 30 with main Priest healer + Monk finisher NPC: server commands (89 confirmed checkpoints), client session with a render view per frame, and runner give the identical final checkpoint and 945 events (digest 4804b1e3), outcome STORY_TIME_LIMIT. Heal/overheal/shield/SP/sphere metrics are per owner:skill; Sanctuary heal ticks carry effect heal_tick and the parent cast token; Kyrie shields are attributed to their cast.

engine_changes: Effect events (heal, shield, resource_change, status_applied/resisted/removed, revive) now carry action_id, source_instance_id and effect_id; cast_start carries its cast token and cast_interrupt names the interrupter's action (D-060). Combat rules and numbers are unchanged.
limitations: No new visuals: icons per skill, in-battle effects reuse family recipes (heal/buff/burst).
Role/encounter numbers are behaviour evidence with probes, not a balance verdict; the 6-20 parity team (two Lv1 companions, no gear) times out. Tuning is TASK-041.
Visual review of each skill animation was not performed.
